items.q: this was inUganda, where they had this King of the -- of Uganda, he had several bands.

ctx.x: I guess -- I called it cow, but it was these horns and they would play, they would -- this was inUganda, where they had this King of the -- of Uganda, he had several bands. He had bands where they had nothing but horns, horns from the cows, and then he had a band that played all drums. And each one of these bands had their own tent. Where they played all over the grounds of his palace. He had
all kinds of drums, he had drums so big that you couldn't hardly -- you couldn't move them they were so big.
